description: Initial characterization space for a ScanTailor-style historical scan page-frame detector. HTH independently implements the documented scan-processing idea of locating content under uneven illumination and then searching outward for the physical page frame; no ScanTailor source code is embedded or translated. The first 243-member grid deliberately varies illumination normalization, content thresholding, morphology, projection smoothing, and outward boundary search width so HTH can determine whether this production scan-processing lineage adds useful evidence beyond its existing page detectors.
